text:
incident-bot: Paging: spike in 5xxs and sustained tail latency in eu-west-2. Alerts: request_error_rate > 4% for 15m, p99 latency > 1.8s. Possible provider quota exhausted. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/eu-edge-failover :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: got it, I'm oncall. checking dashboards now

priya (SRE): looking at provider-A metrics — quota error spikes align w/ 12:03 UTC. backend queues growing on edge-proxy-02.

oncall-alex: can you confirm which customers impacted? maria?

maria (support): quick scan: multiple enterprise tenants in EU seeing errors, some API retries, a few support tickets landing. Ticket numbers: #E-4021 #E-4022. Customers flagged: AcmeCorp, FinBeta.

jen (eng): is this the new adaptive batcher rollout? any correlation?

priya (SRE): no, rollout is green. This looks like provider-A quota cut + regional network congestion. provider-A error type 429 -> converted to 503 by our proxy when retries saturated.

oncall-alex: OK mitigation plan: 1) enable partial brownout: disable nonessential features (rerank service and fuzzy-search) in eu-west-2 2) increase soft-rate-limits for high-priority enterprise keys to keep SLA 3) trigger provider-reroute for eu-west-2 traffic to provider-B 4) start graceful drain of provider-A nodes in region.

ops-bot: action created: /feature-toggle eu-west-2 --disable rerank,fuzzy-search --who=alex --reason="emergency brownout"

oncall-alex: running toggle now

```
/feature-toggle eu-west-2 --disable rerank,fuzzy-search --confirm
```

ops-bot: feature-toggle applied: rerank=frozen, fuzzy-search=frozen (propagation 30s)

priya (SRE): starting provider reroute for eu-west-2 -> provider-B (gradual over 5m). Command: `/route-shift eu-west-2 --from=provider-A --to=provider-B --step=10% --interval=30s`

oncall-alex: execute it and monitor 5xx and cost delta, prioritize enterprise traffic.

```
/route-shift eu-west-2 --from=provider-A --to=provider-B --step=10% --interval=30s --preserve-keys=enterprise
```

ops-bot: route-shift initiated: step=10% every 30s

priya (SRE): 30s update: +10% to provider-B. 5xx down from 4.1% -> 3.2%. p99 from 1.9s -> 1.6s. provider-B latency slightly higher for small fraction but acceptable.

tom (infra): starting graceful drain on provider-A edge instances in eu-west-2 to stop new sessions that will route to provider-A. Using drain window 300s.

```
/drain-nodes --region eu-west-2 --provider provider-A --grace 300
```

oncall-alex: also bump soft-qps for enterprise keys (temporary)

```
/adjust-quota --region eu-west-2 --keys AcmeCorp,FinBeta --qps +50
```

ops-bot: quota adjusted for AcmeCorp, FinBeta (+50 qps) by alex

maria (support): letting the enterprise reps know. Templated message queued: "We're actively mitigating a regional provider issue; some non-essential features are temporarily disabled. We'll update in 15m."

jen (eng): we should also flip on circuit-breaker fallback to smaller local model to reduce provider load for tail requests. Could save token cost too.

priya (SRE): good call. Enabling fallback-model route for EU traffic (low-risk route for <1000 token requests).

```
/enable-fallback --region eu-west-2 --model small-eu-fallback --threshold 1000
```

ops-bot: fallback route enabled; applying to 100% of traffic under threshold

priya (SRE): 10m update: error rate down to 1.1%, p99 steady at 1.4s. provider-A errors reduced as drain completes. Cost on provider-B increased ~12% — monitoring.

oncall-alex: next steps: keep route-shift running until provider-A quota restored, keep brownout in place. Prepare rollback plan to re-enable features after stabilization. If errors stay <1.5% for 20m, prepare to scale back steps.

tom (infra): tickets opened with provider-A support, ticket #PA-7789. They confirm a regional billing quota enforcement at 11:58 UTC — they are escalating.

maria (support): updated customers with expected timeline: 30-45m. Prioritized support channels enabled for AcmeCorp/FinBeta.

jen (eng): I'll queue a canary to re-enable rerank in 20m behind a scoped flag if stable.

priya (SRE): 25m mark: metrics stable, 5xx at 0.9%. propose to start reversing route-shift in controlled way once provider-A confirms quota lifted or after 40m.

oncall-alex: agreed. Preparing a formal incident summary for handoff to next oncall.

oncall-alex: Handoff -> priya will take next 2h watch. My notes: actions taken: partial brownout (rerank/fuzzy disabled), provider reroute to provider-B, graceful drain provider-A, enterprise qps bump, fallback-model enabled, customer comms. Open follow-ups: confirm provider-A quota resolution, cost impact review, add auto-detect rule for provider quota 429->reroute.

priya (SRE): taking watch. Acknowledged.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Created incident-1981234567 in tracker. Severity: Sev2.

oncall-alex: thanks team. :thumbsup:
